req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} must set completed=true and return HTTP 2xx. I design: (1) a positive EP test marking an incomplete task complete, asserting exact status 200 and completed==true; (2) a STC test verifying the state transition from completed=false to completed=true, then asserting the GET reflects the change; (3) a BVA test using a task already completed=true (idempotent re-mark), asserting completed remains true; (4) a NEG test for a non-existent task_id returning exactly 404; (5) a DT test sending only {"completed": true} (partial update) to confirm title/description are preserved; (6) a NEG test sending an invalid payload (title violating max_length=100) to confirm 422 rejection. All tests use in-process TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to remain deterministic and idempotent.

import os, tempfile
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', '')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
DB_URL = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
engine = create_engine(DB_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

from app import models
with TestingSession() as s:
    s.add(models.Task(id=4, title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix', completed=False))
    s.commit()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true():
    r = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['completed'] == True
    assert body['id'] == 4

test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tf.name)
